properties.name: A DesignRule constructor, a change-event description redirect, and a skill pointer to external_dependency
properties.rationale:
WHAT WAS DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT, and why — the fourth item from my own recommendation was dropped after reading the code. Defaulting acknowledge_gap's `approver` to the session contributor would attach the OWNER'S authority to an acknowledgement the agent often makes on its own; that is the forgery `rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word` and `dec:certainty-derived` exist to prevent. The warning the qs report wanted silenced is the guard working, so it stays. This is the fix-properly discipline picking correctness over the reporter's literal ask.

THE THREE THAT SHIPPED are all additive (no schema change, no behaviour change to existing calls) and each targets a repeat: DesignRule-no-constructor (dev_storyflow 2026-08-23 + qs 2026-09-04), the change_event description mistake (three projects, the third AFTER it was documented — proof a tool description is not read mid-work while a refusal is), and external_dependency-unfindable (qs). The change_event redirect cost 11 test-literal edits because AddChangeEventReq gained a field — test-only churn, production builds via serde.

WHAT IS PARTIAL: the DesignRule report also carried a FALSE claim (enforced defaults true) that measurement refuted; the constructor makes the right behaviour reachable but does not change that enforced was never defaulted. The change_event redirect fixes ONE of the four round-trips that report named (description); the other three (affected shape, change_type enum, subject enum) are serde errors that already enumerate their values and are untouched. external_dependency now has an instruction leg but still no detector-that-notices-absence, and find_tools still did not surface it for the reporter's query.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three additive surface fixes clearing the multi-project repeats from the 2026-09-04 field triage. (1) `add_design_rule` — a typed constructor (name, statement, optional category, optional enforced), so a DesignRule is no longer writable only through generic create_node with guessed field names; two independent projects hit this. `enforced` stays Option and is never defaulted. (2) `add_change_event` now ACCEPTS a `description` field only to reject it with a message naming `summary` and `rationale` — the commonest mistake, made by three projects including one after it was documented, now teaches at the moment of failure instead of via a bare serde field-list. (3) link-projects and adopt now point at `external_dependency` for 'a repo we depend on but do not own' — the qs project could not find the tool that already existed. Files: graph.rs, service.rs, tools/capture.rs, tools/temporal_tools.rs, two SKILL.md (+ .claude/.grok mirrors), toolsnaps regenerated (add_design_rule new, add_change_event changed). Tests: four new in tools.rs (constructor with/without enforcement, redirect fires, redirect silent on a normal call), all observed. core 1578/0, mcp 347/0, skill_lint and toolsnap green.
